verdict.rationale: x402's Facilitator includes built-in OFAC/KYT screening that declines sanctioned or high-risk addresses, and a Coinbase PM publicly floated future plans to 'charge unverified bots' or 'users who exceed rate limits,' but there is no documented merchant-facing feature to allowlist/denylist specific agents or agent platforms by identity, nor a rate-limiting dashboard/API for catalog or checkout access. missing for 10: agent/platform identity allowlist-denylist controls, per-agent rate-limit configuration UI/API, evidence the roadmap comment shipped.
